local function setGameMusicSuppressed(bool3: boolean)

        local PlayerScripts = LocalPlayer:FindFirstChild("PlayerScripts")

        if PlayerScripts then
            PlayerScripts = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage").Controllers
        end

        if PlayerScripts then
            PlayerScripts = PlayerScripts:FindFirstChild("AudioClient")
        end

        if PlayerScripts and PlayerScripts:IsA("ModuleScript") then
            local success, result = pcall(require, PlayerScripts)

            if success then
                var2 = result
            end
        end
    end

    if var2 and var2.SetEventMusicSuppressed then
        pcall(var2.SetEventMusicSuppressed, bool3)
    end
end

local var3 = nil

local function shakeOnImpact()
    if not var3 then
        local var4 = CameraShaker.new(Enum.RenderPriority.Camera.Value + 1, function(arg1)
            local CurrentCamera = workspace.CurrentCamera

            if CurrentCamera then
                CurrentCamera.CFrame *= arg1
            end
        end)

        var4:Start()
        var3 = var4
    end

    var3:ShakeOnce(6, 12, 0.1, 0.6)
end

local function attachTrail(arg1)
    if arg1:IsA("Model") then
        arg1 = arg1.PrimaryPart
    end

    if not arg1 then
        return
    end

    local Attachment: Attachment = Instance.new("Attachment")
    local y = arg1.Size.Y / 2 + 0.4
    Attachment.Position = Vector3.new(0, y, 0)
    Attachment.Parent = arg1
    local Attachment2: Attachment = Instance.new("Attachment")
    local y2 = arg1.Size.Y / 2 - 0.4
    Attachment2.Position = Vector3.new(0, y2, 0)
    Attachment2.Parent = arg1
    local Trail: Trail = Instance.new("Trail")
    Trail.Attachment0 = Attachment
    Trail.Attachment1 = Attachment2
    Trail.Lifetime = 1.1
    Trail.LightEmission = 1
    Trail.Color = ColorSequence.new(Color3.new(1, 1, 1))
    Trail.Transparency = NumberSequence.new({ NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0, 0), NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0.7, 0.25), NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(1, 1) })
    Trail.WidthScale = NumberSequence.new({ NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0, 1.4), NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(1, 0.6) })
    Trail.FaceCamera = true
    Trail.Parent = arg1
end

local function riseNukeFromSilo(tbl1)
    local var4 = NukeVisual.build(tbl1.Tier, {
        name = "MeltdownSiloNuke",
        withOverhead = false
    })

    if not var4 then
        task.wait(tbl1.RiseTime)

        return
    end

    local Scale = tbl1.Scale or 3
    local Y

    if var4:IsA("Model") then
        var4:ScaleTo(Scale)
        Y = var4:GetExtentsSize().Y

        for _, descendant in var4:GetDescendants() do
            if descendant:IsA("BasePart") then
                descendant.CanQuery = false
                descendant.CanTouch = false
                descendant.CastShadow = false
            end
        end
    else
        var4.Size *= Scale
        Y = var4.Size.Y
        var4.CanQuery = false
        var4.CanTouch = false
        var4.CastShadow = false
    end

    attachTrail(var4)
    local Position = workspace.Center:GetPivot().Position
    local var5 = -Y
    local var6 = tbl1.RiseHeight - var5
    var4.Parent = workspace.CurrentCamera
    local num1 = os.clock()

    while true do
        local num2 = math.clamp((os.clock() - num1) / tbl1.RiseTime, 0, 1)
        local var7 = Position + Vector3.new(0, 1, 0) * (var5 + var6 * num2 * num2)
        local targetCFrame = NukeBallistics.orientation(var7, Vector3.new(0, 1, 0), 0)

        if var4:IsA("Model") then
            var4:PivotTo(targetCFrame)
        else
            var4.CFrame = targetCFrame
        end

        if num2 >= 1 then
            local TargetPosition = tbl1.TargetPosition
            local FlightTime = tbl1.FlightTime
            local ArcHeight = tbl1.ArcHeight

            if TargetPosition and FlightTime and ArcHeight then
                task.spawn(function()
                    local var8 = Position + Vector3.new(0, 1, 0) * tbl1.RiseHeight
                    local num3 = os.clock()
                    local var9 = var8

                    while var4.Parent do
                        local num4 = math.clamp((os.clock() - num3) / FlightTime, 0, 1)
                        local var10 = NukeBallistics.arc(var8, TargetPosition, num4, ArcHeight)
                        local var11 = var10 - var9
                        local targetCFrame2 = NukeBallistics.orientation(var10, var11, num4)

                        if var4:IsA("Model") then
                            var4:PivotTo(targetCFrame2)
                        else
                            var4.CFrame = targetCFrame2
                        end

                        if num4 >= 1 then
                            break
                        end

                        RunService.RenderStepped:Wait()
                        var9 = var10
                    end

                    var4:Destroy()
                end)

                return
            end

            var4:Destroy()

            return
        end

        RunService.RenderStepped:Wait()
    end
end

local function playSiloLaunch(tbl2)
    local CityModel = workspace:WaitForChild("CityModel")
    local SiloDoor = CityModel:WaitForChild("SiloDoor")
    local SiloLaunchVFX = CityModel:WaitForChild("SiloLaunchVFX")
    local Animator = SiloDoor.AnimationController.Animator
    local var4 = AnimationController:Play(Animator, 133831286058861)
    var4.Priority = Enum.AnimationPriority.Action

    var4.Stopped:Once(function()
        if var1 then
            var1:Stop(0)
        end

        local var5 = AnimationController:Play(Animator, 119837384893258, 0)
        var5.Priority = Enum.AnimationPriority.Idle
        var5.Looped = true
        var1 = var5
    end)

    if tbl2.TargetUserId == LocalPlayer.UserId and tbl2.FlightTime then
        task.delay(tbl2.LaunchTime + tbl2.RiseTime + tbl2.FlightTime, shakeOnImpact)
    end

    local Part = SiloDoor:FindFirstChild("Part")
    local Color = if Part and Part:IsA("BasePart") then Part.Color else nil

    if Part and Color then
        local propertyTable = {
            Color = Color32
        }
        TweenService:Create(Part, TweenInfo.new(tbl2.LaunchTime, Enum.EasingStyle.Cubic, Enum.EasingDirection.Out), propertyTable):Play()
    end

    task.delay(tbl2.LaunchTime, function()
        ForgeVFX.emit(SiloLaunchVFX)

        if Part and Color then
            local propertyTable = {
                Color = Color
            }
            TweenService:Create(Part, TweenInfo.new(1.6), propertyTable):Play()
        end

        riseNukeFromSilo(tbl2)

        if var4.IsPlaying then
            var4.Stopped:Wait()
        end

        closeSiloDoor(Animator)
    end)
end

function module.Start(_)
    MeltdownCutscene.OnClientEvent:Connect(function()
        if bool1 then
            return
        end

        bool1 = true
        bool2 = true
        setGameMusicSuppressed(true)
        Players.LocalPlayer:SetAttribute("MeltdownCutsceneActive", true)
        playIntroCutscene()
        bool1 = false
        Players.LocalPlayer:SetAttribute("MeltdownCutsceneActive", false)
    end)

    MeltdownEnded.OnClientEvent:Connect(function()
        bool2 = false
        setGameMusicSuppressed(false)
    end)

    MeltdownSiloLaunch.OnClientEvent:Connect(playSiloLaunch)
end

return module
